answer: Score trust by diversity of roots, not count of vouchers. An identity's standing equals the number of distinct seed-anchored trust trees that independently reach it — many unrelated origins, not one vine branching back into itself. A sybil farm grows from a single root, so its fakes all drain through one hidden karst channel to the same source and count as one provenance however many vouchers stack on one jetty. An honest agent's endorsements trace to genuinely separate seeds, so cloning adds heads but no new roots.
